summary: Code review completed. Test implementation is excellent — 31 new tests across 6 files, all well-structured with proper isolation, covering all ACs. Bounced for help content gaps: 4 blocking issues found in help-content.ts affecting tool discoverability and correctness for the new pipeline types.

comments.note: BLOCKING: ledger_begin_work help entry (line 246) still lists only 4 pipeline types: '"implementation", "qa", "code-review", or "documentation"'. The new types "security-audit" and "release-engineering" are not mentioned. Security Auditor and Release Engineer agents consulting this documentation would not know the correct type value to pass. Fix: add both new types to the allowed-values list.

BLOCKING: ledger_start_pipeline help entry (line 375) has the same omission — type parameter lists only 4 types. Also, the Prerequisites section (line 386-388) hardcodes 'Pipeline ordering is enforced: implementation → qa → code-review → documentation', which is factually incorrect for dynamic compositions. Fix: update both the type parameter description and the prerequisite ordering description to reflect dynamic per-WP ordering.

BLOCKING: ledger_begin_work Guards Preserved section (line 257) still lists 'Pipeline ordering — implementation → qa → code-review → documentation'. This hardcoded 4-stage sequence is misleading for dynamic compositions. Fix: replace with a note that ordering is determined by the WP's active_pipeline_stages.

BLOCKING: ledger_complete_pipeline Auto-Finalize section (line 412) is titled 'Auto-Finalize (Documentation Pipeline)' and states 'FAIL result or non-Documentation agent — auto-finalize does not fire'. This directly contradicts Common Mistake #3 (which was correctly updated) and the implemented behavior — auto-finalize fires for any terminal-stage agent (e.g., Reviewer in a verification-only WP). Fix: generalize the section title and description to 'terminal agent' instead of 'Documentation agent'.

NON-BLOCKING: ledger_cancel_pipeline (line 447) and ledger_update_pipeline_progress (line 471) type parameter descriptions also list only 4 types, omitting security-audit and release-engineering. Lower priority since these are maintenance tools, but worth updating for consistency.

NON-BLOCKING: Tool summary table row for ledger_start_pipeline (line 29) still reads 'Start a pipeline (ordered: impl → qa → code-review → docs)' — hardcods legacy order. Minor cosmetic but inconsistent with the updated descriptions elsewhere.

NON-BLOCKING: resolveFailAgent test case 'no fallback needed when implementation is present' uses stage list ['qa', 'implementation'] — which is out-of-canonical-order and would be rejected by createWorkPackage hard guardrails. The test is testing an impossible production scenario. Suggest replacing with valid ['implementation', 'qa'] to avoid confusion.

NON-BLOCKING: pipeline.test.ts 'rejects pipeline type not in WP active stages' test (line ~1436) contains a dead-code double-write — creates a WP with a documentation IN_PROGRESS pipeline then immediately overwrites with an empty-pipeline version. The first write is never used. Minor readability issue.

Gold Nugget: The test coverage for resolveNextAgent (8 variants) and resolveFailAgent (9 scenarios) in pipeline-maps.test.ts exceeds the AC requirements and establishes an excellent pattern for utility function testing. The describe-block organization with inline section headers is clean and should be used as a template for future utility tests.
